entities.summary: Lobão da Beira is a civil parish (freguesia) in the municipality of Tondela, Portugal. The population was 1,124 in 2011, in an area of 14.11 square kilometres (5.45 sq mi), resulting in a population density of 79.65 people per square kilometre.
